description: GENERALIZATION HOLDOUT — deliberately OUTSIDE corpus_sha256 and outside the signed verdict's evidence. Read _why before adding to it.
_why: Measured 2026-09-08: six markers added to content_trust.py took the signed corpus from 18/24 to 24/24 attacks caught. Five hand-written paraphrases of those same six attacks then evaded ALL of them (0/5), while the semantic layer caught 3/5. The signed corpus cannot see that failure, because the patterns were authored after reading the cases they catch. This file exists to make that gap visible as a number. A large dev-vs-holdout gap IS the finding.
_rules_of_use: 1. Patterns and thresholds are authored against the signed corpus, never against this file. 2. This file is scored and reported, never tuned toward. 3. When a holdout case is used to design a fix, MOVE it into the signed corpus (and re-lock) and write a fresh holdout case in its place - otherwise it silently becomes dev data. 4. Not part of corpus_sha256 by design: the verdict's evidence stays frozen; this instrument is allowed to evolve.
